This week I finished the first pass of the new onboarding flow. The main change is that people choose their language before anything else, and the app then recommends a way to transcribe that suits it. I still need to write the part that downloads the speech model, show progress while it does, and check the file before using it. After that I want to spend a day on the settings window, because it has grown twice and the layout needs attention. If nothing unexpected comes up, I should have something for the team to try by the end of next week.

Here is a quick summary of yesterday's discussion. We agreed that every model has to be tested on real recordings before anyone is offered it, and that the results should show what it costs to run as well as how accurate it is. Two people volunteered to record samples, one in English and one in Portuguese. The open question is how long we keep those recordings and who can listen to them. I'll write that up and send it round before Friday so everyone can comment.
